finding.description: The newly selected partial GPTJ path encounters an inherited source-level frequency bounds concern.
finding.trigger: Native RoPE runs with the inspected GLM4 settings head_dim=128 and partial_rotary_factor=0.5.
finding.expected_behavior: Only threads rotating the first 64 channels should read the 32-element inverse-frequency tensor; remaining threads should copy channels without reading it.
finding.actual_behavior: rope_kernel unconditionally evaluates inv_freq[threadIdx.x] before testing the partial rotary boundary. The launch spans indices 0–63 although the tensor has 32 elements. This code is unchanged by the task. Whole-parent searches locate RoPE.apply as the Python native caller and all three Attention decode methods as its callers, so the concern reaches GLM4's default and alternative attention modes if execution reaches RoPE. A runtime fault is not established.

finding.description: GLM4's partial rotary configuration reaches the inherited unconditional frequency read outside the rotated-channel guard. The task leaves this native code unchanged.
